name: Bulk Products Pricing
author: aicoso

sections.description:
Bulk Products Pricing for WooCommerce is a powerful plugin that allows store owners to implement quantity-based pricing strategies. Offer better prices for larger quantities to encourage bulk purchases and increase your average order value.

Key Features

  • Flexible Pricing Rules – Set different prices based on quantity ranges
  • Multiple Pricing Types – Choose between fixed prices, fixed discounts, or percentage discounts
  • Product-Level Control – Enable quantity pricing for individual products
  • Variation Support – Works with both simple and variable products
  • Bulk Application – Apply pricing rules to multiple products or entire categories at once
  • Visual Pricing Table – Display pricing tiers on product pages to encourage larger purchases
  • Tax Calculation Support – Properly calculates taxes on discounted prices
  • Customizable Display – Style the pricing table to match your theme

Use Cases

  • Wholesale Pricing – Offer special prices for bulk buyers
  • Volume Discounts – Encourage larger purchases with tiered pricing
  • B2B Sales – Set up quantity-based pricing for business customers
  • Clearance Sales – Move inventory faster with bulk discounts
  • Manufacturing – Reflect economies of scale in your pricing

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Enable the plugin from the settings page
  3. Set up pricing rules for individual products or apply globally
  4. Customers see the pricing tiers and get automatic discounts based on quantity
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Bulk Products Pricing”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Bulk Products Pricing to configure

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to WooCommerce > Bulk Products Pricing to configure
sections.faq:
Does this work with variable products?

Yes! The plugin supports both simple and variable products. You can set different quantity pricing for each variation.

Can I apply the same pricing to multiple products?

Yes, you can use the Global/Bulk Table feature to apply pricing rules to entire categories or selected products at once.

Will it work with my theme?

The plugin is designed to work with any properly coded WooCommerce theme. The pricing table styling can be customized to match your theme.

Can I show the pricing table on the product page?

Yes, you can enable the pricing table display in the plugin settings. The table colors and styling are customizable.

Does it support tax calculations?

Yes, the plugin properly calculates taxes on the discounted prices when tax calculation is enabled.

Can I set different discount types?

Yes, you can choose between:
– Fixed selling price
– Fixed discount amount
– Percentage discount

Is it compatible with other WooCommerce plugins?

The plugin follows WooCommerce best practices and should work with most other WooCommerce extensions. If you encounter any conflicts, please contact support.

Can I disable it for specific products?

Yes, quantity pricing can be enabled or disabled on a per-product basis.
